name: Feature request

---

## Feature Summary

Provide a short and clear description of the feature.

Example:

* Animated stickers
* Multi-monitor support
* Workspace-specific stickers
* Opacity controls
* Click-through mode

---

## Problem / Motivation

Describe the problem this feature would solve.

Examples:

* Managing stickers across monitors is difficult
* Stickers block mouse interaction
* Need better runtime customization
* Renderer lacks animation support

Explain why this feature would be useful.

---

## Proposed Solution

Describe exactly how you would like the feature to work.

Include:

* Expected behavior
* UI changes
* Runtime behavior
* Configuration changes
* Keyboard/mouse interactions

Example:

```text id="jlwm0cq"
Add a click-through toggle that allows mouse events to pass through stickers while keeping them visible.
```

---

## Alternative Solutions Considered

Describe any alternative implementations or workarounds you considered.

Example:

* Using compositor rules instead of internal support
* Separate daemon process
* External scripting tools

---

## Mockups / Screenshots / References

If applicable:

* Add screenshots
* Draw UI ideas
* Share reference projects
* Attach workflow examples

Useful references:

* Rainmeter
* Conky
* xwinwrap
* KDE widgets
* Live2D desktop tools
